verdict: Leads came in but nothing is converting — two issues being fixed now.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 133 leads from Meta at a cost per lead of $19.24, while the final 7 days showed a pullback — leads down 41.3% and cost per lead up 12.9% versus the prior 7 days, driven by reduced budget pacing rather than a drop in demand. More urgently, Google Ads spent $1,144.71 this period and produced zero conversions — this is a confirmed issue, not a tracking gap, and that spend is being reallocated. On the intake side, 133 leads entered the pipeline but zero converted to appointments or won opportunities, pointing to a gap in the lead-to-booking process that is being closed through the CRM build, due complete by August 31. New landing pages and a fresh creative batch are also due by month end, which should stabilize Meta's efficiency heading into September.
